note_en: The pair 既…也/又… links two qualities or actions, like English "both… and" or, with negatives, "neither… nor": 既不得罪人，也不委屈自己 "neither offending anyone nor shortchanging himself." Each 既 and 也 must sit right before its own verb phrase, so the negative 不 goes after them, not before.
